human_instruction: Implement a read-only deterministic checkpoint command. It must inspect backlog/current-project state, git status --short, git diff --name-only, git diff --stat, latest commit, QA status, and validate-json status. It must return JSON-compatible output including active_issue_id, active_workstream, dirty, changed_files, diff_stat, latest_commit, qa_ok, validation_ok, task_brief_path, recommended_operator_action, and next_human_input_contract. Do not commit, do not push, do not close issues, and do not modify docs/state from checkpoint.
forbidden_actions: Do not close backlog issues automatically.
Do not modify docs/state/backlog.json or docs/state/current-project.json from checkpoint.
